programme.title: Hollywood Or Bust
programme.desc: A movie-mad nitwit driving across the country to his mecca, Hollywood, is joined by a gambler who wants to break into singing when they pick up a pretty girl en route. Once in Hollywood the nitwit meets his dream goddess.

programme.title: Living It Up
programme.desc: fter being mistakenly diagnosed with a terminal illness, Homer Flagg and his doctor accept an all-expenses-paid trip to Manhattan—choosing to go along with the misunderstanding.

programme.title: Three Ring Circus

programme.title: The Bellboy
programme.desc: Lewis stars as Stanley, a non-speaking, bumbling bellhop at the ritzy Fontainebleau Hotel in Florida’s Miami Beach. Guests may come and guests may go, but Stanley is on duty day after day at the posh resort, encountering all sorts of catastrophes.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor
programme.desc: Jerry Lewis directed, co-wrote and starred in this riotously funny movie that set a new standard for screen comedy and inspired the hit remake.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee government assassins after him. He races against the clock in order to discover the truth.

programme.title: Stephen King's Graveyard Shift
programme.desc: When a mill is reopened, several employees meet their deaths. The killings all occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. the Graveyard Shift. Soon, the workers find a maze of tunnels leading to the cemetery and the horror that comes alive at night.

programme.title: Stephen King's Thinner
programme.desc: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Movie
programme.desc: The Wraparound Story concerns a little boy who spins all the tales to distract a witch who wants to pop him in the oven!

programme.title: Fright Night
programme.desc: Meet Jerry Dandridge. He's sweet, sexy, and he likes to sleep in late. You might think he's the perfect neighbor. But there's just one thing you should know. Jerry prefers his drinks warm, red and straight from the jugular! Rated: R

programme.title: Jimi: All Is By My Side
programme.desc: A drama based on Jimi Hendrix's life as he left New York City for London, where his career took off.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood’.

programme.title: The Blind Swordsman: Zatoichi

programme.title: Iron Monkey (1993)
programme.desc: Presented by Quentin Tarantino, Iron Monkey is the spirited tale of a mysterious and mythical Chinese legend in this exhilarating non-stop martial arts excitement.

programme.title: Hero ("Ying Xiong")

programme.title: Moms' Night Out

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: What to Expect When You're Expecting

programme.title: Deep Purple - Live in Verona
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks.

programme.title: Peter Gabriel - New Blood: Live in London
programme.desc: Filmed at the Hammersmith Apollo in March 2011, New Blood - Live In London captures Peter Gabriel performing live with the 46 piece New Blood Orchestra.

programme.title: Elton John: Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Filmed at the Roundhouse in London, this concert film gives fans a live experience from start to finish; Elton John performs his hits: "Tiny Dancer," "Rocket Man," "Your Song," and many more.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor
programme.desc: Jerry Lewis directed, co-wrote and starred in this riotously funny movie that set a new standard for screen comedy and inspired the hit remake.

programme.title: Don't Give Up The Ship
programme.desc: New bridegroom called to D.C. to explain what happened to a navy destroyer escort gone since WWII.

programme.title: Operation Petticoat
programme.desc: A submarine captain and his supply officer are determined to get their dry-dock sub back into WWII action. However, a bevy of nurses comes aboard, causing hijinks in the hot pink sub.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee government assassins after him. He races against the clock in order to discover the truth.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Fright Night
programme.desc: Meet Jerry Dandridge. He's sweet, sexy, and he likes to sleep in late. You might think he's the perfect neighbor. But there's just one thing you should know. Jerry prefers his drinks warm, red and straight from the jugular! Rated: R

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: THE BLOB has returned in this horrific tale about a vile, malignant life-form that crashes to earth in a cozy, rural American town called Arborville. Untroubled by conscience or intellect, the Blob does only one thing-and does it well. Rated: R

programme.title: Stephen King's Silver Bullet
programme.desc: Something is killing off townsfolk in Tarker's Mills. Something ingenious. Something remotely human. But the only person in town with courage to stop this lurking menace is a 13-year-old boy, confined to a wheelchair since birth.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood’.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick ass heroes.

programme.title: Slice
programme.desc: In a spooky small town, when a slew of pizza delivery boys are slain on the job, two daring survivors (Atlanta's Zazie Beetz and Chance the Rapper in a wild film debut) set out to catch the culprits behind the cryptic crime spree.

programme.title: Hero ("Ying Xiong")
programme.desc: Acclaimed by critics and loved by audiences around the world, Jet Li, Maggie Cheung, and Donnie Yen star in this Oscar and Golden Globe-nominated action-packed epic, in which a fearless warrior rises up to defy an empire and unite a nation.

programme.title: House of Flying Daggers
programme.desc: Mei is an exotic, beautiful blind dancer, associated with a dangerous revolutionary gang, known as the House of Flying Daggers. Captured by officers of the decadent Tang Dynasty, Mei finds herself both threatened. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: From director Wong Kar Wai and starring Tony Leung and Ziyi Yang, THE GRANDMASTER is an epic action film inspired by the life of Ip Man, the legendary kung fu master who trained Bruce Lee.

programme.title: What to Expect When You're Expecting
programme.desc: A hilarious and heartfelt big-screen comedy about five couples whose intertwined lives are turned upside down by the challenges of impending parenthood.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: If you've always wanted to know what a baby thinks of the world around him, you finally have your chance. With Bruce Willis supplying the voice of Mikey's thoughts, this is one baby who says exactly what's on his mind. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: John Travolta and Kirstie Alley return in this charming sequel to the $100 million box-office smash. Also starring the voices of Bruce Willis as Mikey, Rosanne Barr as his new baby sister and Mel Brooks as the voice of Mr. Toilet Man.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Can't Hardly Wait
programme.desc: It's graduation day at Huntington Hills High and that means one thing: Party! In one epic night, hearts will be broken, and new romances will blossom for six teens facing the rest of their lives - but not until the party ends!

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island and finds out some places never let you go.

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Tom is a young man who believes it's better to be a fake somebody than a real nobody. Finally, A wealthy American shipbuilder hires Tom to travel to Italy to bring back his playboy son.

programme.title: The Tailor of Panama
programme.desc: Based on the 1996 novel, this is a mixture of thriller and black comedy. Harry Pendel is the tailor to the powerful of Panama. Harry is known for his storytelling and suits, but soon his tales carry lethal repercussions.

programme.title: Tears of the Sun
programme.desc: After a West African president's family is assassinated and civil unrest is rampant, a top-secret team is deployed to the far reaches of the jungle to rescue a U.S. doctor who is acting as a missionary.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: The Boy In The Striped Pajamas
programme.desc: A forbidden friendship forms between Bruno, the son of a Nazi commandant, and Schmuel, a Jewish boy held captive in a concentration camp. Though separated physically by a barbed wire fence, their lives become inescapably intertwined.

programme.title: House of Gucci
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Young Guns
programme.desc: In a lawless and violent time, six young outcasts are hired by an English merchant as 'regulators' to guard his ranch against the mob, a corrupt and powerful ring.

programme.title: Young Guns II
programme.desc: The West has changed since The Regulators last rode through. Cornered by the ruthless cattle kings and double-crossed by corrupt government officials, Billy the Kid leads the Regulators down a treacherous trail towards Old Mexico… and destiny.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise Of Cobra
programme.desc: They are G.I. Joe, a top-secret elite strike force featuring the best operatives from around the globe. After a secret weapon is stolen by the evil Cobra, the G.I. Joes must stop Cobra from plunging the world into chaos.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: Project Almanac
programme.desc: When five teens discover a machine that can send them back in time, the possibilities seem endless. But by changing the past, they have threatened the future of our world. Can they undo the damage they have unleashed before it’s too late?

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: A couple find themselves in over their heads when they foster three children

programme.title: Stepmom
programme.desc: An unlikely friendship develops when a mother of two is forced to teach another woman to raise her kids. Julia Roberts and Susan Sarandon star.

programme.title: Same Kind Of Different As Me
programme.desc: From The NY Times bestseller comes an inspirational true story about two men from drastically different backgrounds, who develop a surprising bond that will lead them on the most remarkable journey of their lives and forge an everlasting friendship.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Christine's former marriage counselor comes into the gym, leading to some awkward moments between the two women.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: When Richard and "new" Christine want to take Ritchie to a Rolling Stones concert, Christine initially forbids it. Eventually, she relents but immediately regrets her decision.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Shut out once again by the judgmental moms at Ritchie's school, Christine is overjoyed to finally make friends with another down-to-earth working woman, Belinda.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: While volunteering at the spring carnival at Ritchie's school, Christine is surprised to learn that there's a hot new dad at the school—and excited that it's her ex-boyfriend, Burton.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: In the season premiere, it's the first day of fourth grade for Ritchie. No longer dating New Christine, Richard stays with Christine while he builds a new laundry room for her. But problems arise when Ritchie misinterprets the comfortable arrangement.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Worried about Richard's indiscriminate dating habits and reluctantly realizing that she misses New Christine as well, Christine vows to bring the couple back together.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: A winter vacation to Mars and a cute ski instructor test Sabrina’s feelings for Harvey.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: When Sabrina uses Libby’s likeness to promote a community service program, the real Libby manages to steal the limelight.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina’s first kiss becomes a test of true love when Harvey is turned into a frog.

programme.title: The Relic
programme.desc: Come in—if you dare. The opening-night gala for a new exhibit at Chicago's natural history museum is underway. But be advised: something terrifying wants to make sure no one ever leaves.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers
programme.desc: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of a old church, Trish and her brother Darry watch their routine road trip home turn into a heart stopping race for their lives. They are now the chosen prey of a force that relentlessly pursues them.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: The Creeper terrorizes a group of varsity basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches who are stranded on a highway after their bus breaks down. Fighting their own fears and prejudices the group of athletes are forced to come together to stay alive.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: In 2047, a team of astronauts embarks on a mission to retrieve a missing spaceship. However, their simple retrieval job leads to something far more terrifying than any of them would suspect.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: A blind girl receives a cornea transplant so that she is able to see again. However, she gets more than she bargains for when she realizes she can see disturbing ghosts.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Terms of Endearment dazzled critics and audiences alike with its believable, insightful story of two captivating people, mother and daughter, unforgettably played by Shirley MacLaine and Debra Winger.

programme.title: Heartburn
programme.desc: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship Heartburn, nothing will!

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: In & Out
programme.desc: A former student who's now an actor tells an audience of millions that Howard is gay. He's outed when he didn't know he was in! Kevin Kline plays Howard, scrambling to go forth with his wedding and doing his best to assert his manliness.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A neurotic, twice divorced sci-fi writer moves back in with his mom to solve his personal problems.

programme.title: Dear God
programme.desc: Special delivery for comedy fans! Greg Kinnear ( Auto Focus) stars in and Garry Marshall ( Pretty Woman) directs this spirit-lifter about a money-scamming con artist who goes from no-good to doing good.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Pain & Gain
programme.desc: When an ambitious group of personal trainers go after the American Dream, they get caught up in a criminal enterprise that goes horribly wrong. Now, living large will take everything they've got in this unbelievable and outrageous true story.

programme.title: The One
programme.desc: In a stunning dual role, international action star Jet Li portrays Gabriel Yulaw, a police officer confronted with a sinister form of himself escaped from an advanced, parallel universe and intent on killing Gabriel.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this action thriller about a man who awakens in another man’s body to discover only he has the ability to stop a terrorist attack on a commuter train.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: The split-second moments that can take a life down one path instead of another form the tantalizing 'what if?' in this delightful romantic comedy starring Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: The Usual Suspects
programme.desc: A gruesome scene adorns a pier in San Pedro, south of Los Angeles. Twenty-seven dead bodies. A burned-out ship smoldering in the harbor.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnam soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Boxcar Bertha
programme.desc: Set in the Depression era of the 1930s, a young woman and three men rob trains and plan a kidnapping. The men are caught and the woman becomes a prostitute. Based on "Sister of the Road" by Boxcar Bertha Thomson as told to Ben L. Reitman.

programme.title: The Mortal Instruments
programme.desc: Clary's life is turned upside down when her mother is kidnapped and it's revealed that they are shadowhunters who are tasked with protecting the world from vampires, werewolves and demons. Clary must discover her talents and save her mother.

programme.title: The Craft: Legacy
programme.desc: In Blumhouse's continuation of the cult hit The Craft, an eclectic foursome of aspiring teenage witches get more than they bargained for as they lean into their newfound powers.

programme.title: The Covenant
programme.desc: To the students of the Spenser Academy, the Sons of Ipswich are the baddest boys on campus. But that's not all they share. The four friends also share a 300-year-old secret: they're warlocks, the teenage descendants of a 17th-century coven of witches.

programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days

programme.title: Peter Gabriel - New Blood: Live in London

programme.title: Elton John: Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Filmed at the Roundhouse in London, this concert film gives fans a live experience from start to finish; Elton John performs his hits: "Tiny Dancer," "Rocket Man," "Your Song," and many more.

programme.title: Chic: Live in London 2013
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out 3-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in February 2008 when Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969.

programme.title: Operation Petticoat
programme.desc: A submarine captain and his supply officer are determined to get their dry-dock sub back into WWII action. However, a bevy of nurses comes aboard, causing hijinks in the hot pink sub.

programme.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
programme.desc: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama as a submarine commander (Gable) drives his men and his 1st officer (Lancaster) to the brink of mutiny in his quest to sink an enemy sub. Robert Wise directs.

programme.title: South Pacific
programme.desc: On a South Pacific island during World War II, love blooms between a young nurse and a secretive Frenchman who's being courted for a dangerous military mission.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: THE BLOB has returned in this horrific tale about a vile, malignant life-form that crashes to earth in a cozy, rural American town called Arborville. Untroubled by conscience or intellect, the Blob does only one thing-and does it well. Rated: R

programme.title: Stephen King's Silver Bullet
programme.desc: Something is killing off townsfolk in Tarker's Mills. Something ingenious. Something remotely human. But the only person in town with courage to stop this lurking menace is a 13-year-old boy, confined to a wheelchair since birth.

programme.title: Stephen King's Graveyard Shift
programme.desc: When a mill is reopened, several employees meet their deaths. The killings all occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. the Graveyard Shift. Soon, the workers find a maze of tunnels leading to the cemetery and the horror that comes alive at night.

programme.title: Stephen King's Thinner
programme.desc: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick ass heroes.

programme.title: Slice
programme.desc: In a spooky small town, when a slew of pizza delivery boys are slain on the job, two daring survivors (Atlanta's Zazie Beetz and Chance the Rapper in a wild film debut) set out to catch the culprits behind the cryptic crime spree.

programme.title: Da Sweet Blood of Jesus
programme.desc: Spike Lee's stylized thriller DA SWEET BLOOD OF JESUS is a new kind of love story that questions the very nature of love, addiction, sex, and status in our seemingly sophisticated society.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: From director Wong Kar Wai and starring Tony Leung and Ziyi Yang, THE GRANDMASTER is an epic action film inspired by the life of Ip Man, the legendary kung fu master who trained Bruce Lee.

programme.title: Iron Monkey (1993)
programme.desc: Presented by Quentin Tarantino, Iron Monkey is the spirited tale of a mysterious and mythical Chinese legend in this exhilarating non-stop martial arts excitement.

programme.title: Hero ("Ying Xiong")
programme.desc: Acclaimed by critics and loved by audiences around the world, Jet Li, Maggie Cheung, and Donnie Yen star in this Oscar and Golden Globe-nominated action-packed epic, in which a fearless warrior rises up to defy an empire and unite a nation.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: If you've always wanted to know what a baby thinks of the world around him, you finally have your chance. With Bruce Willis supplying the voice of Mikey's thoughts, this is one baby who says exactly what's on his mind. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: John Travolta and Kirstie Alley return in this charming sequel to the $100 million box-office smash. Also starring the voices of Bruce Willis as Mikey, Rosanne Barr as his new baby sister and Mel Brooks as the voice of Mr. Toilet Man.

programme.title: Moms' Night Out
programme.desc: All Allyson and her friends want is a long-needed moms' night out. But to enjoy it, they need their husbands to watch the kids for a few hours-what could go wrong?

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

programme.title: Center Stage
programme.desc: The American Ballet Company is not for the fainthearted, it's for the most gifted and beautiful ballet dancers alive. But you'll need more than mere physical prowess and determination to succeed. PG-13

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: The Tailor of Panama
programme.desc: Based on the 1996 novel, this is a mixture of thriller and black comedy. Harry Pendel is the tailor to the powerful of Panama. Harry is known for his storytelling and suits, but soon his tales carry lethal repercussions.

programme.title: Tears of the Sun
programme.desc: After a West African president's family is assassinated and civil unrest is rampant, a top-secret team is deployed to the far reaches of the jungle to rescue a U.S. doctor who is acting as a missionary.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: The Boy In The Striped Pajamas
programme.desc: A forbidden friendship forms between Bruno, the son of a Nazi commandant, and Schmuel, a Jewish boy held captive in a concentration camp. Though separated physically by a barbed wire fence, their lives become inescapably intertwined.

programme.title: House of Gucci
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.

programme.title: Trumbo
programme.desc: Screenwriter Dalton Trumbo's career comes to a crushing halt in the 1940s when he and other Hollywood figures are blacklisted for their political beliefs as he goes to war with the U.S. government and studio bosses over words and freedom.

programme.title: Young Guns II
programme.desc: The West has changed since The Regulators last rode through. Cornered by the ruthless cattle kings and double-crossed by corrupt government officials, Billy the Kid leads the Regulators down a treacherous trail towards Old Mexico… and destiny.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie. However, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: Project Almanac
programme.desc: When five teens discover a machine that can send them back in time, the possibilities seem endless. But by changing the past, they have threatened the future of our world. Can they undo the damage they have unleashed before it’s too late?

programme.title: A-X-L
programme.desc: A.X.L. is a top-secret, robotic dog created by the military to help protect tomorrow's soldiers. Code named by the scientists who created him, A.X.L. stands for Attack, Exploration, Logistics, and embodies next-generation artificial intelligence.

programme.title: Stepmom
programme.desc: An unlikely friendship develops when a mother of two is forced to teach another woman to raise her kids. Julia Roberts and Susan Sarandon star.

programme.title: Same Kind Of Different As Me
programme.desc: From The NY Times bestseller comes an inspirational true story about two men from drastically different backgrounds, who develop a surprising bond that will lead them on the most remarkable journey of their lives and forge an everlasting friendship.

programme.title: August: Osage County
programme.desc: Meryl Streep and Julia Roberts lead an all-star cast. A family crisis unites a dispersed group of siblings at the Oklahoma house they grew up in with the dysfunctional woman who raised them.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina’s first kiss becomes a test of true love when Harvey is turned into a frog.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Salem enters a cat show to make some fast cash, but Sabrina uncovers a fur-raising scandal.

programme.title: Kim's Convenience
programme.desc: Appa's reputation as an impartial umpire faces a stiff test. Jung and Kimchee disagree about discipline. Janet worries a sweater may be haunted.

programme.title: Kim's Convenience
programme.desc: Kimchee's plan to impress the higher-ups backfires. Shannon inadvertently insults Umma's cooking. Appa and Janet enter a prank war.

programme.title: Kim's Convenience
programme.desc: Umma tries to set up Janet with their new mason. Shannon encourages Jung to give Appa a gift. Kimchee and Shannon work on employee evaluations.

programme.title: Kim's Convenience
programme.desc: Janet and Appa take a first aid course. Umma worries her prayers cause more harm than good. Shannon and Jung discuss their relationship.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: When Moesha’s car breaks down, she, Hakeem, and Niecy are late for their graduation ceremony.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: A frustrated Moesha longs for a promotion from 'gopher' to writer at Vibe magazine but believes that her boss, Joe Scott, would rather she pay her dues with something other than her writing talent.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Eager to get on the fast track at Vibe Magazine, Moesha pretends to be a reporter to land a Maya Angelou interview. But her ambition, coupled with Maya’s advice, leads Moesha down an entirely different path than she’d planned.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: The Creeper terrorizes a group of varsity basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches who are stranded on a highway after their bus breaks down. Fighting their own fears and prejudices the group of athletes are forced to come together to stay alive.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: In 2047, a team of astronauts embarks on a mission to retrieve a missing spaceship. However, their simple retrieval job leads to something far more terrifying than any of them would suspect.

programme.title: Species
programme.desc: She's beautiful, seductive, intelligent, and her charms could spell doom for the entire human race! Ben Kingsley, Forrest Whitaker, and Natasha Henstridge star in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi hit.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: As a couple welcome a newborn baby into their home, a demonic presence begins terrorizing them, tearing apart their perfect world and turning it into an inescapable nightmare.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: Paranormal Activity 3 takes you back to where it all began, and the activity is more intense than ever. The cameras are on and recording the chilling moments when evil begins to terrorize young sisters Katie and Kristi for the first time.

programme.title: Heartburn
programme.desc: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship Heartburn, nothing will!

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Terms of Endearment dazzled critics and audiences alike with its believable, insightful story of two captivating people, mother and daughter, unforgettably played by Shirley MacLaine and Debra Winger.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A neurotic, twice divorced sci-fi writer moves back in with his mom to solve his personal problems.

programme.title: Dear God

programme.title: She's All That
programme.desc: A high school jock makes a bet that he can turn an unattractive girl into the school's prom queen.

programme.title: Leon Bridges -- Live in London 2015
programme.desc: American singer-songwriter Leon Bridges performs his top tracks at the Apple Music Festival in London in 2015.

programme.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
programme.desc: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama as a submarine commander (Gable) drives his men and his 1st officer (Lancaster) to the brink of mutiny in his quest to sink an enemy sub. Robert Wise directs.

programme.title: South Pacific
programme.desc: On a South Pacific island during World War II, love blooms between a young nurse and a secretive Frenchman who's being courted for a dangerous military mission.

programme.title: The 400 Blows
programme.desc: A young boy, left without attention, delves into a life of petty crime.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee government assassins after him. He races against the clock in order to discover the truth.

programme.title: Stephen King's Thinner
programme.desc: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Movie
programme.desc: The Wraparound Story concerns a little boy who spins all the tales to distract a witch who wants to pop him in the oven!

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: THE BLOB has returned in this horrific tale about a vile, malignant life-form that crashes to earth in a cozy, rural American town called Arborville. Untroubled by conscience or intellect, the Blob does only one thing-and does it well. Rated: R

programme.title: Da Sweet Blood of Jesus
programme.desc: Spike Lee's stylized thriller DA SWEET BLOOD OF JESUS is a new kind of love story that questions the very nature of love, addiction, sex, and status in our seemingly sophisticated society.

programme.title: Def By Temptation
programme.desc: An evil succubus is preying on libidinous black men in New York City, and all that stands in her way is a minister-in-training, an aspiring actor, and a cop who specializes in cases involving the supernatural.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Hero ("Ying Xiong")
programme.desc: Acclaimed by critics and loved by audiences around the world, Jet Li, Maggie Cheung, and Donnie Yen star in this Oscar and Golden Globe-nominated action-packed epic, in which a fearless warrior rises up to defy an empire and unite a nation.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Ip Man is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, the grandmaster of the Wing Chun style of kung fu and sifu of legendary martial arts superstar, Bruce Lee.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Newly arrived in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man encounters stiff opposition when he begins teaching the Wing Chun fighting style. But instead of bowing to his rivals' demands, he perseveres and retaliates with amazing speed and power.

programme.title: Moms' Night Out
programme.desc: All Allyson and her friends want is a long-needed moms' night out. But to enjoy it, they need their husbands to watch the kids for a few hours-what could go wrong?

programme.title: Somebody Up There Likes Me
programme.desc: Nick Offerman (Parks and Recreation) stumbles through life with his best friend and the woman they both adore (Jess Weixler) in this smart, subversive comedy about watching your life fly by.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: Center Stage
programme.desc: The American Ballet Company is not for the fainthearted, it's for the most gifted and beautiful ballet dancers alive. But you'll need more than mere physical prowess and determination to succeed. PG-13

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: In & Out
programme.desc: A former student who's now an actor tells an audience of millions that Howard is gay. He's outed when he didn't know he was in! Kevin Kline plays Howard, scrambling to go forth with his wedding and doing his best to assert his manliness.

programme.title: Tears of the Sun
programme.desc: After a West African president's family is assassinated and civil unrest is rampant, a top-secret team is deployed to the far reaches of the jungle to rescue a U.S. doctor who is acting as a missionary.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Honeymoon
programme.desc: Young newlyweds Paul (Harry Treadaway) and Bea (Rose Leslie) travel to a remote lake cottage for their honeymoon, the promise of private romance awaits them. Shortly after arriving, Paul finds Bea wandering and disoriented in the middle of the night.

programme.title: House of Gucci
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.

programme.title: Trumbo
programme.desc: Screenwriter Dalton Trumbo's career comes to a crushing halt in the 1940s when he and other Hollywood figures are blacklisted for their political beliefs as he goes to war with the U.S. government and studio bosses over words and freedom.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie. However, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Duel at Diablo
programme.desc: Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

programme.title: A-X-L
programme.desc: A.X.L. is a top-secret, robotic dog created by the military to help protect tomorrow's soldiers. Code named by the scientists who created him, A.X.L. stands for Attack, Exploration, Logistics, and embodies next-generation artificial intelligence.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: A man goes on the run after he discovers that he is actually a "harvested being", and is being kept along with others in a utopian facility.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise Of Cobra
programme.desc: They are G.I. Joe, a top-secret elite strike force featuring the best operatives from around the globe. After a secret weapon is stolen by the evil Cobra, the G.I. Joes must stop Cobra from plunging the world into chaos.

programme.title: August: Osage County
programme.desc: Meryl Streep and Julia Roberts lead an all-star cast. A family crisis unites a dispersed group of siblings at the Oklahoma house they grew up in with the dysfunctional woman who raised them.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Eager to get on the fast track at Vibe Magazine, Moesha pretends to be a reporter to land a Maya Angelou interview. But her ambition, coupled with Maya’s advice, leads Moesha down an entirely different path than she’d planned.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Unable to resist the temptations of college life, Moesha and Niecy become regulars on the party circuit, until their attendance at a late-night frat party takes its toll in more ways than one.

programme.title: The Steve Harvey Show
programme.desc: Steve participates in a bachelor auction where a beautiful young bidder turns out to be a front for an older woman.

programme.title: The Steve Harvey Show
programme.desc: After Steve's extravagant plans fall apart, he rings in the new millennium with Regina, Cedric and Lovita.

programme.title: The Steve Harvey Show
programme.desc: Cedric (Cedric "the Entertainer") prefers reliving his wild days rather than going to Steve's (Steve Harvey) bachelor party. With Wendy Raquel Robinson.

programme.title: The Steve Harvey Show
programme.desc: A sexist school board member ignores Regina's funding proposal while green-lighting Steve's harebrained ideas.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: When the dry cleaners misdeliver her favorite dress to a woman who then dies, Melanie crashes the funeral with Victoria, Joy and Elka to retrieve it undetected.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Melanie, Victoria and Joy put their Midwestern neighbors on an L.A. weight-loss regimen, while Elka lies about her age to keep up with spontaneous thrill-seeker Roy.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Victoria dates a hand model, Roy's mother dislikes Elka, Joy can't figure out the age of the guy she's seeing, and Melanie's boyfriend resembles Winnie-the-Pooh.

programme.title: Species
programme.desc: She's beautiful, seductive, intelligent, and her charms could spell doom for the entire human race! Ben Kingsley, Forrest Whitaker, and Natasha Henstridge star in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi hit.

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Seven complete strangers of widely varying personality characteristics are involuntarily placed in an endless maze containing deadly traps.

programme.title: The Relic
programme.desc: Come in—if you dare. The opening-night gala for a new exhibit at Chicago's natural history museum is underway. But be advised: something terrifying wants to make sure no one ever leaves.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: Paranormal Activity 3 takes you back to where it all began, and the activity is more intense than ever. The cameras are on and recording the chilling moments when evil begins to terrorize young sisters Katie and Kristi for the first time.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 4
programme.desc: Katie disappeared with her nephew Hunter with no survivors. Five years later she's returned with a mysterious boy, ready to target new victims with her demonic rage in a quiet neighborhood.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
programme.desc: The activity is back and has claimed a new victim. Jesse has been hearing horrifying sounds from his neighbor’s apartment, but when he sets out to uncover their source, he encounters an ancient evil that won’t rest until it’s claimed his soul.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Terms of Endearment dazzled critics and audiences alike with its believable, insightful story of two captivating people, mother and daughter, unforgettably played by Shirley MacLaine and Debra Winger.

programme.title: Heartburn
programme.desc: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship Heartburn, nothing will!

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: Oklahoma!

programme.title: The Island

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Christine urges Ritchie's school principal (NANCY LENEHAN - My Name Is Earl) to let the class take the subway on a field trip in order to learn real-world skills.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine

programme.desc: Sabrina casts a spell on herself to become an instant Kung-Fu master.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: A Christmas Eve catnapping renews Salem’s love for his family.

programme.title: The Woman in Black

programme.title: Terms of Endearment

programme.desc: Theresa y Karl acusan a Pedro de que la maestra los castigo por su culpa, deciden atacar a Heidi y Pedro hasta que llegan a la antigua mansión del abuelo, en el ático quedan atrapadas Heidi y Theresa, los chicos deben unirse para ayudarlas.

programme.title: Heidi: Cuidado con el lobo
programme.desc: Una cabra es atacada mientras Heidi se encuentra un cachorro, lo que no sabe es que es un pequeño Lobo. En el pueblo vaga una loba que acaba de atacar a una cabra y el pueblo teme por que sean atacados.

programme.title: Heidi: El tesoro de Pedro
programme.desc: La primavera ya regreso y Pedro y Heidi están listos para abrir la casa del árbol, se da cuenta Pedro que su tesoro no esta, ellos sabe quienes fueron, el abuelo les aconseja un plan para que los delincuentes confiesen.

programme.title: Heidi: Ataque en la casa del árbol
programme.desc: William, Karl y Theresa toman la casa del árbol, furioso Pedro quiere usar la fuerza para sacarlos, pero Heidi tiene un plan más creativo para espantar a los chicos de la casa del árbol.

programme.title: Heidi: Salvando a Encanto
programme.desc: La pequeña cabra que fue atacada por el Lobo ya no quiere dar leche, los dueños quieren sacrificarla, pero Heidi hace un último intento con amor para que la cabra vuelva a dar leche. ¿lo logrará?

programme.title: Heidi: El fin de la primavera
programme.desc: La tía de Heidi regresa al pueblo para llevarse a Heidi a Frankfurt, el abuelo se niega a dejarla ir, después de una discusión con la tía accede que se lleven a Heidi. Pedro y el abuelo no quieren que se vaya.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Los chicos están sintiendo la presión por los exámenes escolares. Mientras tanto, hay una ola de robos en el vecindario de los Pickles. Todas las pistas indican que Dil sería el ladrón.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Betty decide llevar al grupo a hacer canotaje. Aunque al principio, parece una aventura sin riesgos en el río, el peligro se asoma cuando los chicos se separan de los adultos y Tommy revela su miedo al agua.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Ansioso por saber qué le compraron sus padres como regalo de cumpleaños, Kenan se mete en su habitación y encuentra un paquete, pero Kel lo rompe por accidente. Ahora los chicos tienen que correr para reemplazar el regalo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel destruye las fotos para el anuario de la escuela, y ahora él y Kenan deben ayudar a su compañero Marc Cram a reemplazar las fotos.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel salen a pasear y deciden entrar en una tienda de ropa, pero una serie de hechos desafortunados hacen que Kenan acabe perdiendo su camisa y su pantalón. Como resultado, Kenan queda atrapado en la tienda en ropa interior.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan quiere invitar a Sharla al Baile del Amor, pero tiene miedo de preguntarle, así que le dice a todos que irá al baile con Tamia, una cantante famosa. Pero primero debe conocer a la chica y convencerla de ir al baile con él.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Chris se va de vacaciones y deja a Kenan y Kel a cargo de su casa por unos días. Parece que todo está bajo control, sin embargo las cosas empiezan a ir terriblemente mal ¡cuando se olvidan de cuidar la casa!

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan se convierte en un héroe cuando captura a un peligroso criminal en la tienda de comestibles Rigby's. Cuando el criminal escapa de la prisión, decide ir a la casa de Kenan para vengarse.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan conoce a una chica rica y alquila una limusina llevarla al restaurante más caro de la ciudad. El problema es que no contaba con que Kel se metiera en el medio para arruinar todo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que Pokemon GO comenzó como una simple broma?. Encendemos motores para repasar la cronología de Mario Kart. Y te hablaremos de UnMetal, un juego al que, si eres fan de Metal Gear.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Nintendo solo hace videojuegos, ¿cierto? ¡Falso!, la empresa japonesa ha tenido otros negocios diferentes desde su fundación, y en Expansion Pack te lo contamos. Repasamos la legendaria vida de Master Chief. Además, la retroreseña de Super Metroid.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Los esports continúan creciendo cada vez más, en Expansion Pack te hablaremos al respecto. Platicamos acerca de Metal: Hellsinger, un juego ideal si lo tuyo es la acción frenética y el heavy metal; y nos ponemos mitológicos para repasar God of War.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Érase una vez, un evento de videojuegos tan grande, que todo el mundo quería estar en él nos referimos al E3, y en Expansion Pack nos pondremos nostálgicos para recordar cómo era este show. Como broche de oro, honraremos obra de Shigeru Miyamoto.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este Expansion Pack te presentaremos un top dedicado a algunas de las interpretaciones más memorables. Repasaremos la evolución de una de las sagas más emblemáticas de Xbox: Gears of War y te contaremos todo acerca del origen de adorable Kirby.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este episodio de Expansion Pack, te diremos todo lo que debes saber acerca de la Gamescom, el evento de videojuegos más grande de Europa. Veremos a detalle la trayectoria de Lara Croft; y viajaremos al pasado para recordar al legendario Dino Crisis.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Es hora de iniciar un nuevo nivel de Expansion Pack, conoceremos cómo surge la ESRB, también veremos la evolución de la legendaria saga “Príncipe de Persia”, y echaremos un vistazo a esos juegos que fueron tan buenos que cambiaron a su género.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Los Game Awards, en Expansion Pack te volverás experto en uno de los eventos más importantes para el gaming, recordaremos al maravilloso “Pilot Wings 64”, y reconoceremos a los maestros de la música en los videojuegos.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: ¿Conoces las diferencias ente Remaster, Remake y Reboot? En este episodio de Expansion Pack te las contamos. Veremos cómo “Street Fighter”, ha cambiado con el paso de los años; y sentimos el terror con las creepypastas más famosas en videojuegos.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: Law acude para ayudar a Luffy y le hace un extraño ofrecimiento: quiere que hagan una alianza para acabar con uno de los Cuatro Emperadores del Nuevo Mundo, aunque por ahora se desconoce de cuál se trata.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: Parece que Luffy ha entendido lo que quería Law respecto a la alianza, así que dan los primeros pasos para secuestrar a Caesar e investigar la droga con mayor detenimiento.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: La llegada de Luffy supone el comienzo de una dura pelea contra Smoker en el cuerpo de Tashigi, pero la llegada de una extraña criatura venenosa enviada por Caesar altera bastante los planes que tenían ambos.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: Comienza una pelea a muerte entre Luffy y Caesar. Parece que Luffy tiene muchas posibilidades de ganar, pero Caesar, ayudado en parte por sus Smilies, hace que la situación dé un giro realmente inesperado.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: Sanji sigue empeñado en encontrar el torso de Kin'emon, que se encuentra en el fondo del lago envenenado. Cuando finalmente lo consigue, el cuerpo de Kin'emon queda completo y este les da una pequeña muestra de su verdadero poder.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: Después de que atraparan a los Sombrero de Paja y a Law, aparece Vergo nuevamente y finalmente se descubre cuál es su verdadera identidad y qué es lo que está haciendo en Punk Hazard.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: Caesar regresa a las ruinas de los laboratorios donde se encuentran Nami, Usopp y los niños con la intención de llevárselos de vuelta, ya sea por las buenas o por las malas.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: Parece que el plan de Caesar por fin va avanzando como él desea y Smiley va camino de convertirse en un arma de destrucción masiva. No obstante, Caesar ya es consciente de lo que ocurrió hace cuatro años y ha procurado que esta vez sea más potente.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: Smiley se ha convertido en un arma de destrucción masiva perfecta gracias al enorme conocimiento de Caesar.

programme.title: One Piece - Punk Hazard Saga
programme.desc: Gracias a la maniobra conjunta de Franky y Law, todos los que estaban dentro de la jaula consiguen quedar en libertad y se preparan para lanzar el contraataque.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Masato, quien ha estado desaparecido por un tiempo, regresa a la lavandería. Mari y los demás lo interrogan para saber por qué, pero él se niega a responder.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Yuji y Masato descubren el secreto del otro y, mientras tanto, Yuji es atacado por un Orphenoc que revela que quiere convertirse en un nuevo miembro de Lucky Clover.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Faiz (Takumi) y Kaixa (Masato) luchan contra los miembros de Lucky Clover, pero Kyoji Murakami interviene y le ofrece a Masato un lugar de Lucky Clover, que pronto rechaza, y ambos bandos vuelven a enfrentarse.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Takumi y Masato tienen dificultades cuando se enfrentan a Takuma y Saeko, quienes usan sus cinturones. Masato es secuestrado por ellos, pero Takumi es salvado por Keitaro y Mari cuando arrojan la camioneta sobre Takuma y Saeko.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Tal vez es momento de admitir que sí le robaste a tu mamá 5 dólares para comprarte una salchipapa, o que esas revistas inapropiadas que encontraron en tu casillero sí son tuyas. Tranquilo, no eres el único con secretos que contar. Dale play al episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Imagina tener control z en una película de terror. Los protagonistas pagarían la luz a tiempo y no abrirían la puerta donde está el asesino, pero entonces no habría película. Disfruta estos sketches de miedo para que te mueras de la risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Existen situaciones peores que la muerte. Como andar de fiesta y descubrir 20 llamadas perdidas de tu mamá. Mira el episodio de hoy y disfruta con estas situaciones para morir de la risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Contrario a lo que muchos piensan, la vida sí es como en las películas. Pero una película de bajo presupuesto. Dale play al episodio y se le estrella de tu propio película... bueno el extra del fondo.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Has pensado que pasaría si la realidad se mezclara con la ficción? Mira estos sketches y descúbrelo.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: El secreto de la vida es saber mezclar. Hay mezclas clásicas pero también existen mezclas prohibidas como la pizza con piña, o vacilarte a tu prima. Las mezclas de hoy son igual de extrañas, pero te prometemos que van a sacarte una risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Hoy queremos ofrecerte un escape de la realidad. Dale un giro a la normalidad con estos 6 sketches y diviértete viendo como sería tu día a día si estuvieras dentro de una película. Y no, el nopor no cuenta como película. Dale play.

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen
programme.desc: El segundo partido comienza en el Olympia Coliseum y, con los dos luchadores recibiendo ayuda no solicitada de sus respectivos compañeros de equipo, Kai logra derrotar a Johnny.

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen
programme.desc: Los Bladebreakers llegan a Moscú en anticipación del último torneo mundial de Beyblading. Mientras buscan su hotel en la ciudad fría, se encuentran con Boris, un hombre extraño que dice ser el jefe de un centro de entrenamiento de Beyblading.

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen
programme.desc: Los Bladebreakers se encuentran con algunos viejos amigos en Rusia cuando All Starz y el Clan Tigre Blanco aparecen para un combate de exhibición.

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen
programme.desc: Kai se debate entre escapar de la Abadía, ahora conocida como Biovolt Corporation (un acrónimo de Beybladers con la intención de superar la tiranía sin ley), o explorarla más en un intento por desentrañar los recuerdos olvidados de su infancia.

programme.title: BeyBlade Gen
programme.desc: Es el primer día del Campeonato Mundial de Beyblade en Moscú, y cuando los Bladebreakers abandonan el hotel, todavía no han podido localizar a Kai, que ha estado desaparecido durante algún tiempo.

programme.title: Heidi: El fin de la primavera

programme.title: Heidi: La promesa

programme.title: Heidi: El regreso de papá

programme.title: Heidi: Estudiando en casa
programme.desc: El maestro de Clara regresa de sus vacaciones, para su sorpresa Heidi aún no sabe leer ni escribir por lo que tendrán que separar a las dos amigas ya que su nivel escolar es diferente.

programme.title: Heidi: Preparando un espectáculo
programme.desc: La abuela de Clara llega a cambiar el ambiente de la casa, se da cuenta que el maestro es muy académico. Gracias a la obra que la abuela le enseña a Heidi ella aprender a leer, la abuela se encargará de la educación de las chicas.

programme.title: Heidi: En el parque
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara salen al parque, las chicas conocen a Rudy. Heidi y Rudy van corriendo jugando y Clara trata de alcanzarlos, lamentablemente Clara cae de su silla de ruedas, queda lastimada y Heidi está preocupada ya que a lo mejor Clara y no podrá caminar.

programme.title: Heidi: Clara se pone de pie
programme.desc: Despúes de su accidente Clara no quiere salir de su habitación. La abuela y Heidi intentan animarla pero no lo logran, en secreto Clara esta practicando para poder volver a caminar.

programme.title: Heidi: Cabras en la ciudad
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara dan una vuelta de nuevo por el parque, descubren que el parque hay cabras, pero la más bebé esta enferma. Heidi se la lleva a casa para curarla pero debe apresurarse antes de que regrese la señorita Rottenmeier.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1996, más de una docena de niños en Seattle, Washington, luchaban por sus vidas. Cada uno de ellos había contraído una enfermedad grave desconocida. Después de que uno murió, los investigadores sabían que el reloj estaba corriendo.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: El fuego envuelve la casa donde Lori Keidel y sus hermanos se quedaron solos mientras su padre iba a la lavandería. Años después de la desaparición de su madre, Lori le dice a la policía que fue testigo de la muerte de su madre.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Los jóvenes navajos del suroeste estaban muriendo a un ritmo alarmante. Los curanderos de la tribu proporcionaron a los investigadores una pista fundamental que llevaría al otro lado del mundo al asesino más improbable.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Edward Post preparó un baño para su esposa antes de salir a correr. Regresó y la encontró sin respirar. Murió antes de que llegara la ambulancia. La policía consideró su muerte como accidental hasta que surgió un motivo.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Las mujeres en una ciudad de Louisiana viven con el temor de un violador que no deja pistas sobre su identidad. Pero la tecnología y la ciencia del comportamiento se combinan para brindar a la policía una nueva herramienta forense.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Cuando encuentran muerta a la esposa de un dentista bien conocido, la policía se esfuerza por identificar a un sospechoso. Algunas fibras y un estudio de los patrones climáticos en la noche del asesinato abren el caso y revelan al asesino.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra a Joann Katrinak muerta en un campo de maíz con su hijo pequeño, el sospechoso más obvio es el esposo y padre de las víctimas.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Kong – El Rey de los Monos

programme.title: Ma ma

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Tras el ataque, Kane entierra a sus amigos y se propone vengar sus muertes. Reúne un nuevo equipo y sigue el camino que cruza la frontera hasta Vancouver.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: El equipo de Kane se une a la CIA en Vancouver para atrapar al abogado que golpeó su precinto y espera que su captura conduzca al autor intelectual del ataque.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Misión Secreta

programme.title: Tres Ladrones y un Bebé

programme.title: Rápido y Peludo

programme.title: Love & Other Drugs

programme.title: What's Your Number?

programme.title: Runaway Jury

programme.title: Frontera Hostil

programme.title: Lazarus

programme.title: Secuestro Maldito

programme.title: Sed de Venganza

programme.title: Sed de Venganza en la Sangre

programme.title: Sentenciados a Muerte: Guerilleros del Sur

programme.title: La Venenosa

programme.title: Las Cenizas Del Diputado

programme.title: Las Tapatias Nunca Pierden

programme.title: Código de honor

programme.title: Peligro en la montaña

programme.desc: Cuento Southparkitero del libro "Grandes Esperanzas" de Dickens, teniendo como protagonista a Pip, un inglés de clase pobre, y con Malcolm McDowell, un británico como narrador.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se enoja porque Kenny consiguió una consola de videojuegos y él no. Pero Kenny muere al llegar al nivel 60, y va al cielo y se entera que Dios lo mató a propósito ya que lo necesitan para que salve al cielo de un ataque de Satanás.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En Halloween, los chicos quieren asustar a los de quinto grado, así que desentierran el cadáver de la abuela de Kyle. Mientras tanto, la banda Korn está en South Park y unos fantasmas piratas asechan a los habitantes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan investiga por qué son decorados los huevos de Pascua, y qué tienen que ver los conejos y los huevos con la muerte de Jesús por sus pecados, por lo que se adentra en una sociedad bizarra con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman encuentra una manera única de tratar con el síndrome de Asperger. Mientras tanto, Stan no parece recuperar su vida a la normalidad, no importa cuánto se esfuerce.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan tiene un nuevo perro llamado Sparky que resulta ser gay, por lo que todos sus compañeros se burlan de él. Cuando Sparky se va de casa, Stan lo busca en el Santuario de Animales del Gran Gay Al y aprende algo sobre la homosexualidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan cumple 102 años y quiere suicidarse, pero al no poder hacerlo, le pide a Stan que lo ayude.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan le regala una corbata que compró en un programa de ventas por 6 mil dólares. Stan trata de venderla en una casa de empeño, pero nadie le ofrece más de 15 dólares.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan intenta borrar su cuenta de Facebook, pero acaba envuelto en el mundo virtual de la red social. Mientras, Kyle agrega a sus amistades a un niño nada popular y comienza a perder amigos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se van de caza con Jimbo, el tío de Stan, y su viejo amigo Ned. Mientras tanto, un volcán está a punto de hacer erupción y la alcaldesa McDaniels aprovecha la oportunidad para promocionar al pueblo de South Park en televisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan quiere aumentar la conciencia acerca del bullying y para eso hace un video de baile que se vuelve popular en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Butters es víctima del abuso de su cruel abuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle se obsesionan tanto con Guitar Hero que llegan al punto de romper récords, lo que hace que Stan considere llegar más lejos consiguiendo un compañero diferente.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan no puede parar de guardar cosas innecesarias en su armario y, al ser enviado con el Señor Mackey para tratar su problema, se da cuenta de que él consejero de la escuela tiene el mismo trastorno de acumulación compulsiva que él.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman siente curiosidad de saber quién es su padre, pero averiguarlo no es una tarea fácil debido a que su madre se acostó con muchos hombres.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando la mamá de Cartman se da cuenta que ya no puede controlarlo busca ayuda de un experto. César Millan, el "susurrador de perros", acepta el reto pero Cartman no cederá sin antes pelear.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman cree que está muerto porque nadie responde a sus acciones. Se da cuenta que está atorado en la Tierra por sus fechorías, por lo que trata de hacer el bien dando regalos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se congela a sí mismo, despertando 500 años en el futuro cuando hay nutrias agresivas y lo peor de todo: ¡No hay Nintendo Wii! ¿Podrá Cartman escapar de ese crudo futuro?

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son desafiados por un grupo de jóvenes bailarines de breakdance, y Stan decide armar un grupo de baile para ganarles.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman sufre un fuerte golpe en la cabeza después de una caída casi fatal. La policía local asume que ahora Cartman tiene poderes psíquicos y lo contratan para resolver casos extraordinarios.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al Gore visita South Park e intenta convencer a Stan, Kyle, Cartman y Kenny para salir a cazar al peligroso hombre-oso-cerdo. Al ayudarlo, los chicos se quedan atrapados en una cueva y mientras tratan de salir, Cartman descubre un tesoro.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Tommy, Fili y Lili faltan a la escuela para conseguir un autógrafo de su jugador de futbol favorito. Mientras tanto, Angélica, Susie y Carlitos participan en un proyecto escolar en donde aprenderán las responsabilidades del matrimonio.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: La fiesta de cumpleaños de Fili y Lili se aproxima, pero sus planes para una fiesta épica se destruyen cuando se dan cuenta de que están llegando a la adolescencia y de que tienen muchas diferencias entre sí.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Harold quiere invitar a salir a Angélica, pero como ella solo tiene ojos para Darryl, él comienza a fijarse en Susie. Al notar que Harold ya no siente lo mismo por ella, Angélica enloquece y quiere recuperarlo.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Carlota se queda sin trabajo, así que decide aprovechar su nuevo tiempo libre para convertirse en una súper mamá. Ella decide que quiere ser la mejor amiga de Angélica y se inscribe en diversas actividades de madre e hija.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: A pesar de sus protestas, Didi obliga a Tommy a ir a la escuela de hebreo para prepararse para su bar mitzvah. Allí Tommy conoce a Rachel y se enamora inmediatamente.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Justo cuando Tommy necesita pasar un tiempo alejado de Dil, los Rugrats van al campamento circense. A Dil lo asignan con los contorsionistas, quienes lo reciben como uno más de su grupo y lo invitan a unirse a ellos en su gira.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Mientras están en el cine, Angélica descubre que los Rugrats se infiltraron para ver una película para mayores de 13 años y planea chantajearlos. Sin embargo, todos terminan atrapados en el centro comercial.

programme.title: Rugrats crecidos
programme.desc: Al sentirse rechazada en su propia casa, Angélica se va a vivir con los Carmichaels, pensando que allí será apreciada. Pero pronto descubre que ellos viven bajo un estricto esquema de actividades, responsabilidades y horarios.

programme.title: Clase de bebé: Vocabulario y números
programme.desc: Palabritas nos presentan un paraguas; cuatro ratoncitos viajan alrededor del mundo en Viajando por el Mundo con los números; y aprendan a contar hasta dos en Los Números De La Granja.

programme.title: Clase de bebé: Vocabulario y números
programme.desc: Únanse a Viajando por el Mundo con los números y conozcan a tres monos; las ardillas de Esconder y Buscar esconden la bellota en el dormitorio; y mucho más.

programme.title: Lo Mejor de BabyFirst
